 FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Hidden element
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Where are you located?
 
 Shrimp Basket has 18 locations across Alabama, Florida, and Mississippi, all rooted in Gulf Coast hospitality. You can explore every location and find the one closest to you here.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Do you offer All-You-Can-Eat specials?
 
 Yes. Shrimp Basket offers All-You-Can-Eat favorites Sunday through Thursday, featuring guest-loved classics throughout the week.Weekly lineup:Sunday: Gulf Popcorn ShrimpMonday: Fried FlounderTuesday: Gulf Steamed ShrimpWednesday: Gulf Popcorn ShrimpThursday: Fried FlounderAvailability may vary by location. Check with your local Shrimp Basket for details.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Do you have a full bar?
 
 Absolutely. Every Shrimp Basket location features a fully stocked bar, serving up everything from ice-cold beer to signature cocktails like our famous Bushwackers.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 How can I make a reservation?
 
 Shrimp Basket operates on a first-come, first-served basis. This allows us to keep things casual, flexible, and welcoming for everyone who walks through our doors.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Do you offer Catering?
 
 We do. Shrimp Basket catering is available through your local restaurant, making it easy to bring your favorite seafood to your next gathering. Contact your nearest location to discuss menu options and availability.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Do you offer outdoor seating?
 
 Yes. All Shrimp Basket locations offer outdoor seating, so you can enjoy your meal with a little fresh air and coastal sunshine.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Can I purchase your gourmet hot sauce online?
 
 Our signature hot sauce is available exclusively at Shrimp Basket restaurants. Swing by any location to take a bottle home with you.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 How can I contact Shrimp Basket?
 
 Contact details for each Shrimp Basket location can be found here.For marketing or sponsorship inquiries, please email marketing@shrimpbasket.com
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Do you offer delivery?
 
 Yes! We offer delivery. You can place your order right here!

 A day at the beach escape 
 
 
 
 It all began in 1993, when two locals in Gulf Shores, Alabama decided to open up a casual family-focused seafood restaurant on the Gulf Coast. The idea was to create a restaurant where people would feel welcome to be themselves, families could afford to dine out together and strangers would leave as friends.

Coastal vacationers demanded that Shrimp Basket expand to provide this incredible seafood value to those unable to be at the beach year round.

Today, we’re happy to offer locations across the Southeast for family and friends to feel a part of the beach, dine and enjoy delicious seafood!

At the Shrimp Basket, our goal is to make sure that you - our friends - leave happy and satisfied after every visit. Because with us, you are much more than a customer- you’re part of our family. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Earning Loyalty By Keeping It Real and Uncomplicated 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 LOVED BY LOCALS 
 
 
 
 "We are local to the area and this is one of our favorite places to eat! Food and service is absolutely fantastic!" 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 FELT LIKE FAMILY
 
 
 
 
 "From the time we stepped into the building, we felt right at home. Outstanding food and service. Staff made us feel like we were at a family gathering." 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 A BEACH ESCAPE 
 
 
 
 "What an amazing time we had. The restaurant has a fresh beach emerald-water-and-white-sand look. The drinks were great and the servers were so friendly."
